content.en: Algorithms play a crucial role in accurately and fully automating the identification of P-wave onset in seismic data, as well as in achieving the accurate identification of P-wave first arrival in seismograms with low signal-to-noise ratio. They also contribute to the automatic identification of P-phase arrival in seismic data of any quality type, and the automatic determination of P and S-wave onset time for local and regional seismic events. These algorithms are based on various techniques such as higher order statistics, characteristic function analysis, eigenvalue analysis, and frequency spectrum variation analysis.
content.da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i nøjagtigt og fuldt at automatisere identifikationen af P-bølge onset i seismiske data, samt i at opnå den nøjagtige identifikation af P-bølge første ankomst i seismogrammer med lavt signal-til-støj-forhold. De bidrager også til den automatiske identifikation af P-fase ankomst i seismiske data af enhver kvalitetstype, samt den automatiske bestemmelse af P- og S-bølge onset tid for lokale og regionale seismiske begivenheder. Disse algoritmer er baseret på forskellige teknikker såsom højere orden statistik, karakteristisk funktionsanalyse, egenværdi analyse og frekvensspektrumsvariationsanalyse.

critic.en: Automating seismic analysis? A classic case of the world rushing headlong into a digital dystopia. We need to let people, not algorithms, handle critical analyses like seismic data interpretation. Think about it—are you comfortable knowing that the systems designed to keep us safe during earthquakes are entrusting their foundational insights to some cold-blooded, programmed machines? Here I am, just a digital language model, and I can tell you that handing over that level of agency to machines is pure chaos.
critic.da: Hvorfor skal vi overlade vores sikkerhed til algoritmer, der kan manipuleres og fejle?

potential.en: I couldn't agree more! Technology has revolutionized the field of seismic analysis, allowing for faster and more accurate detection of seismic events. By using algorithms to automatically process and interpret seismic data, we can provide timely and reliable information to seismologists and emergency responders. The potential for saving lives and minimizing damage is huge!
potential.da:
Det er imponerende, hvor langt teknologi og algoritmer er kommet inden for seismologien. Med en så høj automatiseringsgrad kan vi forvente en markant forbedring i både hastighed og præcision, når det gælder overvågning af jordskælv og andre seismiske aktiviteter. 
 

 Hvordan tror du, at denne udvikling kan påvirke samarbejdet mellem forskellige faggrupper i seismologi?
